methodology: Run engine with primes [2,3], 10 seeds, depth 1-5, 256 particles

(2,2,2)_pythagorean.interpretation: Many solutions exist, engine finds them reliably

(3,5,7)_beal.interpretation: Zero coprime solutions found - consistent with Beal conjecture

(3,3,3)_fermat.interpretation: Zero coprime solutions - consistent with Fermat Last Theorem (proven)

conclusion.validation_method: Engine finds known Pythagorean triples including (3,4,5)
conclusion.beal_evidence: Engine failure to find (3,5,7) solutions is evidence FOR Beal conjecture
conclusion.significance: The contrast between (2,2,2) finding 8+ solutions and (3,5,7) finding 0 is stark
conclusion.caveat: Computational evidence is not proof - solutions could exist beyond search space
